definitions.explanation: To bring work to its final stage, adding final touches or completing the last steps.

definitions.gloss: to finish off, to put the finishing touches on
definitions.explanation: To complete something by doing the final work that makes it ready.

examples.japanese: レポートを{今日中|きょうじゅう}に{仕上|しあ}げなければならない。
examples.english: I have to finish the report by the end of today.

examples.japanese: {料理|りょうり}を{美|うつく}しく{仕上|しあ}げる。
{作品|さくひん}が{無事|ぶじ}に{仕上|しあ}がった。
examples.notes: [Note: {仕上|しあ}がる is the intransitive form meaning 'to be finished']

notes:
{仕上|しあ}げる is a transitive verb ({他動詞|たどうし}) meaning to finish or complete.

COMPOUND STRUCTURE:
- {仕|し} (doing) + {上|あ}げる (to raise, to complete) → to complete the work

TRANSITIVITY:
- {仕上|しあ}げる ({他動詞|たどうし}): to finish (something)
- {仕上|しあ}がる ({自動詞|じどうし}): to be finished, to turn out

ASPECT (ている):
{仕上|しあ}げている indicates an ongoing process of finishing work.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {作品|さくひん}を{仕上|しあ}げる (finish a work)
- {きれい|きれい}に{仕上|しあ}げる (finish nicely)
- {完璧|かんぺき}に{仕上|しあ}げる (finish perfectly)
- {仕上|しあ}げの{段階|だんかい} (final stage)

RELATED NOUN:
- {仕上|しあ}げ: finishing, final touches; {仕上|しあ}げ{作業|さぎょう} = finishing work
- {仕上|しあ}がり: finish, result (how something turns out)

[Register: Neutral]
